additional_info.subject: RE: ID0430840-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000683]CCS1 is out of order CRM:02681000315
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
Greetings of the day!
Customer is facing Modbus communication interrupted error on IMD_BC1, due to which CCS1 outlet seems to go Out of Order. This issue occurred repetitively.
We checked in the backend, but currently there is no error. It seems to be temporary error. But customer wants to check the IMD onsite. Hence, kindly communicate with the customer regrading same.
If the issue occurred again, check the following connections on site:
We need to check the tightness of IMD_BC1 connection specially Earth Connection as well as communication. We have reviewed the charger and attempted to fix the issue remotely, but it seems to be an issue with the IMD. We need to check the Modbus connections from IMD BC1. If problem is not resolve please carry a spare IMD: Swap & check
Do let us know, if you have any other queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
